summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K reporting that the CHMP recommended EU approval of Wegovy 7.2 mg in a single-dose pen for obesity, based on STEP UP trials showing 20.7% mean weight loss. The filing is a routine regulatory update on a product recommendation, not a special-situation event. There are no deal terms, acquisition, divestiture, or structural changes. The only actionable item is an expected EU launch in Q3 2026, which is a standard product rollout.
